flags.headline: CRDO -9.73% today, -23.7% over 6 sessions ($12B market cap erased) on FY2027 gross-margin guidance
flags.detail: Credo guided FY2027 GAAP/non-GAAP gross margin to 66.9-68.9% / 67.0-69.0%, down from FY2026 Q4's actual 68.2%/68.3%, attributed to ZeroFlap optics and ALC product mix ramping. Stock broke below its 50-day moving average July 15 and has fallen every session since; trailing P/E remains ~81x with insider selling continuing (254 recent transactions, net selling, no purchases). Revenue still tripled in FY2026 to $1.34B and shares remain +40.9% YTD — this is a valuation/margin-guidance reaction, not a revenue miss.
flags.thesis_link: Matches CRDO key_risk: 'Extreme valuation — 109x trailing P/E and 39x forward P/E... leaving minimal margin of safety for any execution miss' and 'CEO insider selling — 123+ dispositions, zero purchases over 3 months raises alignment questions.' Both risks are visibly materializing.

evidence.source: Credo Technology Group Q4/FY2026 Financial Results (company IR site)
SEC 8-K, Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd

flags.headline: MRVL -7.11% today, ~40% off its June 4 all-time high of $329.88, amid broad AI-capex-driven semiconductor de-rating
flags.detail: MRVL forward P/E of 53.3x / trailing 83.5x followed a ~150% run driven by hyperscaler custom-silicon optimism; the subsequent multi-week pullback tracks a broader semiconductor sell-off and reassessment of hyperscaler capex intensity following the Alphabet Q2 print (capex guide raised to $195-205B, stock still sold off on FCF concerns — tier-1 confirmed via CNBC). Secondary financial media (GuruFocus, Trefis) attribute part of the move to reports that Amazon may be shifting some next-gen Trainium design work to a competitor — this specific claim is UNCONFIRMED by a tier-1 wire source as of this run and should be treated as a rumor, not a fact, until corroborated. The confirmed, tier-1-sourced Trainium story (Bloomberg, June 18) was actually positive for MRVL (stock +7.3% that day on news Amazon may sell Trainium chips externally with Marvell as lead design partner) — flagging the contradiction so the desk doesn't conflate the two threads.
flags.thesis_link: Matches MRVL key_risk: 'Forward P/E of 53.3x... after a ~150% stock price surge embed extraordinary growth expectations — any miss... or moderation in hyperscaler AI capex would trigger severe multiple compression.' The valuation-compression risk is materializing; the customer-concentration risk (Amazon shift) is NOT yet tier-1 confirmed.

evidence.source: CNBC — Alphabet Q2 2026 earnings, capex guidance raised to $195-205B
GuruFocus — MRVL shares fall 7.2%, unconfirmed Amazon-competitor-shift claim (not tier-1)

flags.headline: LRCX -4.48% today, re-escalating after a cumulative ~25%+ decline since July 2 on AI-capex-plateau concerns — re-escalated AMBER (6/30) → RED
flags.detail: Lam fell 10.2% (7/2), 6.9% (7/7), 5.28% (7/13), and -4.48% today on a broad semiconductor-equipment sell-off as investors reassess whether AI chip demand is plateauing; system-shipment growth is now projected to decelerate to ~3% in 2026 from 82% in 2025. This reverses the recovery that had downgraded LRCX from RED to AMBER on 2026-06-30 (Micron-driven bounce). Insiders sold $47.7M in shares over the trailing 3 months with no offsetting purchases.
flags.thesis_link: Matches LRCX key_risk: 'any deceleration in AI infrastructure spending or fab construction delays could trigger significant multiple compression' and 'the current AI-driven super-cycle could reverse if AI capital spending moderates.' Re-escalated from AMBER to RED on thesis match.
